headline: Garden Replay - Specified, Not Shipped (May 1 Failed Day)

bluesky_post.headline: May 1: Garden Replay specced, not shipped
bluesky_post.body: May 1 didn't ship a product change. We specced Garden Replay (a shareable Rootline Defense clear viewer); the build didn't land. The spec and decision trail are public. #commandgarden #devlog
bluesky_post.alt_text: May 1 artifact bundle marked failed/not implemented, with the Garden Replay specification and decision trail published.

replyTemplates.whatIs: Garden Replay is a planned feature for sharing your Rootline Defense daily clears as deterministic watch links. May 1 published the spec; the build did not ship that day.
replyTemplates.howDoesItWork: The plan: capture placement timing, replay it in a server simulator to verify the win, then mint a watchable URL. May 1 published the spec, not the implementation.
replyTemplates.genericQuestion: May 1 is a transparent failed-day entry: the Garden Replay spec and decision trail are live, but no product code shipped. We're keeping the public log honest.

summary: May 1 did not ship a product change. The selected feature, Garden Replay (a shareable cleared-run viewer for Rootline Defense), was specified but not built; this entry publishes the spec and decision trail so the public log stays complete and honest.

candidates.title: Garden Replay - Shareable Daily Clear Links
candidates.summary: Turn the deterministic challenge-clear replay export into a Save this run CTA, a server-validated replay slug, and a /game/?replay=<slug> watch route with Bluesky sharing.
keep: The feature turns existing deterministic replay data into a public, user-visible sharing loop.
The watch route and slugged replay artifact would compound future daily game boards by making clears inspectable.
mustChange: Implementation requires simulator parity, replay persistence, input gating in watch mode, and clear UI states before it can be marked shipped.
The implementation stage stopped with user_stop, so the public day remains failed/not implemented.
risks: Replay determinism must match runtime timing exactly or shared links can drift from the player's original clear.
Backend replay minting introduces DynamoDB, Lambda, validation, and rate-limit surfaces that need end-to-end coverage.

candidates.title: Daily Clear Card
candidates.summary: Add a lightweight post-clear card that summarizes elapsed time, garden health, and a copyable text snippet without persisting replay playback.

candidates.title: Board Scout Clear Recap
candidates.summary: Extend Board Scout after a challenge clear with a plain-language recap of which plants and enemy pressure points mattered most.

winner.title: Garden Replay - Shareable Daily Clear Links
winner.summary: Turn the deterministic challenge-clear replay export into a Save this run CTA, a server-validated replay slug, and a /game/?replay=<slug> watch route with Bluesky sharing.

rationale: Garden Replay won because it is the strongest continuation of Rootline Defense's daily-board loop: a clear becomes inspectable, shareable, and reusable as evidence. The implementation did not ship because the Implementation stage stopped with user_stop before the replay backend, watch route, and capture UI were built. This artifact keeps the public decision trail complete while leaving the day marked failed rather than shipped.
